source.text: Ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι μετ’ αὐτοῦ, τότε καθίσει ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: When then comes the Son of the Man in the glory of him and all the angels with him, then he will sit on throne of glory of him;

en.L: And when the Son of Man comes in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, and all the angels with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sit on [the] throne of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory;
en.B: The Son of Man will come in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, and all the angels with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will take {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seat on the throne of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: The Son of Man will come in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, and all the angels will come with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sit on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious throne.

es.L: Y cuando venga el Hijo del Hombre en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, y todos los ángeles con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, entonces se sentará en [el] trono de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria;
es.B: El Hijo del Hombre vendrá en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, y todos los ángeles con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces ocupará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar en el trono de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: El Hijo del Hombre vendrá en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, y todos los ángeles vendrán con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces se sentará en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono glorioso.

fr.L: Et quand le Fils de l’homme viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, et tous les anges avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’assiéra sur le trône de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire ;
fr.B: Le Fils de l’homme viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, et tous les anges avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prendra place sur le trône de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: Le Fils de l’homme viendra dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, et tous les anges viendront avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’assiéra sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône glorieux.

sw.L: Lakini Mwana wa Adamu atakapokuja katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na malaika wote wakiwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, wakati huo ataketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}};
sw.B: Mwana wa Adamu atakuja katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na malaika wote pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Kisha ataketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Mwana wa Adamu atakuja katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na malaika wote watakuja pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}. Kisha ataketi juu ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi chenye utukufu.

vi.L: Và khi Con Người đến trong vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng với tất cả các thiên sứ với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ngồi trên ngai vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}};
vi.B: Con Người sẽ đến trong vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cùng với tất cả các thiên sứ. Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ngồi trên ngai vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Con Người sẽ đến trong vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tất cả các thiên sứ sẽ đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ngồi trên ngai vinh hiển của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그런데 인자가 자기 영광 가운데 오고 모든 천사가 그와 함께 [올] 때에, 그때에 그는 자기 영광의 보좌에 앉을 것이다.
ko.B: 인자가 자기 영광에 싸여 모든 천사와 함께 올 것이다. 그때 그는 영광스러운 보좌에 앉을 것이다.
ko.R: 인자가 영광 가운데 올 것이다. 모든 천사도 인자와 함께 올 것이다. 그때 인자는 영광스러운 보좌에 앉을 것이다.

am.L: የሰው ልጅም በክብሩ፣ መላእክትም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ሆነው በሚመጣበት ጊዜ፣ በዚያን ጊዜ በክብሩ ዙፋን ላይ ይቀመጣል፤
am.B: የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ፣ መላእክትም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ሆነው ይመጣል። በዚያን ጊዜ በክብሩ ዙፋን ላይ ይቀመጣል።
am.R: የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ ይመጣል፤ መላእክትም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ይመጣሉ። ከዚያም በክብራማ ዙፋኑ ላይ ይቀመጣል።

decisions.choice: the Son of Man coming in glory: Daniel 7:13-14
decisions.reason: In Daniel one like a son of man comes before God and is given glory and a kingdom over all peoples. Jesus applies the picture to himself (24:30; 26:64).

decisions.choice: glory: the splendor and majesty of God's king
decisions.reason: The throne of his glory is the throne from which he rules and judges, as in 19:28.

decisions.choice: he will sit on the throne: the Son of Man is the judge
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself as the one who judges all people (7:22-23; 16:27).

decisions.choice: his, him, he with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Unlike the figures in the parables before it, the Son of Man here is Jesus himself, so his pronouns take the usual span.

decisions.choice: glorious throne
decisions.reason: Readable uses the adjective, which keeps the key term.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on separate pronouns, possessives and clitics before the verb (él, su, mí, mis, me, te, le)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun out ("se sentará") and joins some object pronouns to the verb, where there is nothing separate to capitalise, so the setting covers fewer words than in English. Where a pronoun can stand before the verb ("me fueron a ver"), it does, so it can carry the setting. The same through 25:46.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans again for the Son of Man and the King ("{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire", "{{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez", "{{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu")
decisions.reason: As the English: unlike the figures in the parables before it, the Son of Man here is Jesus himself, so every French pronoun for him carries the span, elided forms included; "je" has none.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns and possessives only (wake, naye, yake, yangu, mimi, kwangu, kwako)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns with a prefix inside the verb (ataketi, mlinipa, tulikuona), which cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as in John. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English through 25:46.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} for the Son of Man through 25:31-46; the King speaks as "Ta"
decisions.reason: As in 16:27 and 19:28: Jesus speaks of the Son of Man in the third person, and Vietnamese gives him the narrator's "Ngài" with the setting, as the English gives the deity_pronoun span. When the King speaks (25:34-45) he is Jesus himself and says "Ta".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Matthew 25:31-46; Jesus speaks of the Son of Man and the King, that is himself, with no honorific ("올", "앉을", "그는")
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; and a Korean speaker does not honour himself, as in the Korean Matthew 16:27 and 19:28. Those who speak to the King use 합쇼체 with "주님".

decisions.choice: "자기 영광의 보좌" (L); "영광스러운 보좌" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Korean Matthew 19:28.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans ("ክብሩ", "ከእርሱ")
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The English lets the reader capitalise pronouns for God and Christ. The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic, and the Amharic text carries no deity_pronoun spans here or in the rest of the passage.

source.text: καὶ συναχθήσονται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ ἀφορίσει αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ ἀλλήλων, ὥσπερ ὁ ποιμὴν ἀφορίζει τὰ πρόβατα ἀπὸ τῶν ἐρίφων, καὶ στήσει τὰ μὲν πρόβατα ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ τὰ δὲ ἐρίφια ἐξ εὐωνύμων.

records.literal_gloss: And will be gathered before him all the nations, and he will separate them from one another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats, \v 33 and he will set the sheep on right of him, the but goats on left.

en.L: And all the nations will be gathered before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will separate them from one another, as the shepherd separates the sheep from the goats, \v 33 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set the sheep on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right, but the goats on [the] left.
en.B: Every nation will be brought together before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will divide the people into two groups, the way a shepherd sorts the sheep from the goats. \v 33 He will stand the sheep at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and the goats at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.
en.R: People from every nation will be gathered in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will separate them into two groups, like a shepherd who separates the sheep from the goats. \v 33 He will put the sheep on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right side and the goats on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left.

es.L: Y serán reunidas delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todas las naciones, y separará a unos de otros, como el pastor separa las ovejas de los cabritos, \v 33 y pondrá las ovejas a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha, y los cabritos a [la] izquierda.
es.B: Todas las naciones serán reunidas delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} separará a la gente en dos grupos, como un pastor aparta las ovejas de las cabras. \v 33 Pondrá las ovejas a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y las cabras a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.
es.R: Gente de todas las naciones se reunirá delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Entonces los separará en dos grupos, como un pastor que separa las ovejas de las cabras. \v 33 Pondrá las ovejas a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha y las cabras a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda.

fr.L: Et toutes les nations seront rassemblées devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les séparera les uns des autres, comme le berger sépare les brebis des chèvres, \v 33 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} placera les brebis à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite, et les chèvres à gauche.
fr.B: Toutes les nations seront rassemblées devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} séparera les gens en deux groupes, comme un berger sépare les moutons des chèvres. \v 33 Il placera les moutons à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et les chèvres à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.
fr.R: Les gens de toutes les nations seront rassemblés devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les séparera en deux groupes, comme un berger qui sépare les moutons des chèvres. \v 33 Il mettra les moutons à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite et les chèvres à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche.

sw.L: Na mataifa yote yatakusanywa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawatenganisha wao kwa wao, kama vile mchungaji anavyowatenganisha kondoo na mbuzi, \v 33 {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawaweka kondoo upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, lakini mbuzi upande wa kushoto.
sw.B: Mataifa yote yatakusanywa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kisha atawagawa watu katika makundi mawili, kama mchungaji anavyowatenga kondoo na mbuzi. \v 33 Atawaweka kondoo upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na mbuzi upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Watu wa kila taifa watakusanywa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kisha atawatenga katika makundi mawili, kama mchungaji anavyowatenga kondoo na mbuzi. \v 33 Atawaweka kondoo upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na mbuzi upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Và tất cả các dân tộc sẽ được nhóm lại trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tách họ ra khỏi nhau, như người chăn chiên tách chiên ra khỏi dê, \v 33 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đặt chiên ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, còn dê ở bên trái.
vi.B: Mọi dân tộc sẽ được tập hợp trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chia họ ra làm hai, như người chăn chiên tách chiên ra khỏi dê. \v 33 Ngài sẽ đặt chiên ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, còn dê ở bên trái.
vi.R: Người thuộc mọi dân tộc sẽ được tập hợp trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chia họ ra làm hai nhóm, giống như người chăn chiên tách chiên ra khỏi dê. \v 33 Ngài sẽ để chiên ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và dê ở bên trái.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 민족이 그 앞에 모일 것이고, 그는 목자가 양들을 염소들에게서 갈라내듯이 그들을 서로 갈라낼 것이다. \v 33 그리고 양들은 자기 오른쪽에, 염소들은 왼쪽에 세울 것이다.
ko.B: 모든 민족이 그 앞에 모일 것이다. 그러면 그는 목자가 양과 염소를 가르듯이 사람들을 두 무리로 가를 것이다. \v 33 양은 자기 오른쪽에, 염소는 왼쪽에 세울 것이다.
ko.R: 모든 나라 사람들이 그 앞에 모일 것이다. 그러면 그는 사람들을 두 무리로 나눌 것이다. 목자가 양과 염소를 따로 나누는 것과 같다. \v 33 그는 양들을 자기 오른쪽에 두고 염소들은 왼쪽에 둘 것이다.

am.L: አሕዛብም ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ እረኛም በጎችን ከፍየሎች እንደሚለይ እርስ በርሳቸው ይለያቸዋል፤ \v 33 በጎቹንም በቀኙ፣ ፍየሎቹን ግን በግራ ያቆማቸዋል።
am.B: የዓለም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰበሰባሉ። እረኛ በጎችን ከፍየሎች እንደሚለይ፣ እርሱም ሰዎቹን ለሁለት ይለያቸዋል። \v 33 በጎቹን በቀኙ፣ ፍየሎቹን ደግሞ በግራው ያቆማቸዋል።
am.R: ከየሕዝቡ ሁሉ የመጡ ሰዎች በፊቱ ይሰበሰባሉ። ከዚያም እረኛ በጎችን ከፍየሎች እንደሚለይ ለሁለት ቡድን ይለያቸዋል። \v 33 በጎቹን በቀኙ በኩል፣ ፍየሎቹን ደግሞ በግራው በኩል ያደርጋቸዋል።

decisions.choice: all the nations: all people of every nation
decisions.reason: "Them" in the next clause is masculine, so the people of the nations are meant, judged one by one. Whether Israel is included is debated; the scene seems to include all humanity.

decisions.choice: the shepherd separates sheep from goats: a daily task
alternatives: a picture of choosing better animals
decisions.reason: Sheep and goats grazed together in one flock and were separated, often at evening. The picture is of a simple sorting, not of the worth of the animals.

decisions.choice: right and left: the place of honor and its opposite
decisions.reason: To sit or stand at a ruler's right hand was the place of favor (Psalm 110:1).

decisions.choice: the people; into two groups
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who is separated and how, following the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: les brebis (L), les moutons (B, R); les chèvres
decisions.reason: "Brebis" is the usual word for sheep in a shepherd's flock and keeps the biblical image at Literal; "moutons" is the everyday word. "Les boucs" names only the males and now sounds like a fixed phrase; the Greek word means goats, often young ones, and "chèvres" says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "tất cả các dân tộc" (L); "mọi dân tộc" (B, R)
decisions.reason: All people of every nation (meaning decision), as in 24:9 and 24:14, not the Gentiles alone.

decisions.choice: "사람들을 두 무리로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable say, the nations are the people of every nation (meaning decision), divided into two groups.

decisions.choice: "አሕዛብ" (L); "የዓለም ሕዝቦች ሁሉ" (B); "ከየሕዝቡ ሁሉ የመጡ ሰዎች" (R)
decisions.reason: "አሕዛብ" usually means the Gentiles, the nations other than Israel. Here all people of every nation are gathered, Israel included (meaning decision m1), so Balanced and Readable say "all the peoples of the world" to keep the narrower sense out.

source.text: τότε ἐρεῖ ὁ βασιλεὺς τοῖς ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ· Δεῦτε, οἱ εὐλογημένοι τοῦ πατρός μου, κληρονομήσατε τὴν ἡτοιμασμένην ὑμῖν βασιλείαν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου.

records.literal_gloss: Then will say the King to those on right of him: Come, the blessed of the Father of me, inherit the having been prepared for you kingdom from foundation of world.

en.L: Then the King will say to those on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right, 'Come, you blessed of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from [the] foundation of [the] world.
en.B: Then the King will say to those at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right, 'Come, you whom {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father has blessed. The kingdom has been ready for you since the world was founded; now it is yours to inherit.
en.R: Then the King will say to the people on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right, 'Come, you people {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father has blessed! Receive the kingdom as your own. It has been ready and waiting for you since the world was made.

es.L: Entonces dirá el Rey a los de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha: “{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, los bendecidos por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre, {{plural_you:reciban|recibid}} en herencia el reino que ha sido preparado para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} desde [la] fundación del mundo.
es.B: Entonces el Rey dirá a los que estén a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha: “{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, a quienes {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre ha bendecido. El reino {{plural_you:les|os}} ha estado preparado desde que el mundo fue fundado; ahora es {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}} como herencia.
es.R: Entonces el Rey dirá a la gente que está a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha: “¡{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, a quienes {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre ha bendecido! {{plural_you:Reciban|Recibid}} el reino como {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}. Ha estado listo, {{plural_you:esperándolos|esperándoos}}, desde que se creó el mundo.

fr.L: Alors le Roi dira à ceux qui sont à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite : “Venez, les bénis de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, héritez du royaume préparé pour vous depuis la fondation du monde.
fr.B: Alors le Roi dira à ceux qui seront à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite : “Venez, vous que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père a bénis. Le royaume est prêt pour vous depuis que le monde a été fondé ; maintenant, il vous revient en héritage.
fr.R: Alors le Roi dira aux gens qui sont à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite : “Venez, vous que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père a bénis ! Recevez le royaume, il est à vous. Il est prêt, et il vous attend depuis la création du monde.

sw.L: Wakati huo Mfalme atasema kwa wale walio upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, 'Njooni, ninyi mlio wabarikiwa wa Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; pokeeni urithi wa ufalme ulioandaliwa kwa ajili yenu tangu misingi ya ulimwengu ilipowekwa.
sw.B: Kisha Mfalme atawaambia wale walio upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, 'Njooni, ninyi ambao Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} amewabariki. Ufalme umekuwa tayari kwa ajili yenu tangu ulimwengu ulipoumbwa; sasa ni urithi wenu.
sw.R: Kisha Mfalme atawaambia watu walio upande wa kulia {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, 'Njooni, ninyi ambao Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} amewabariki! Pokeeni ufalme uwe wenu. Umekuwa tayari ukiwasubiri tangu ulimwengu ulipoumbwa.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Vua sẽ nói với những người ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hãy đến, hỡi những người được Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban phước, hãy thừa hưởng vương quốc đã được chuẩn bị cho các người từ khi sáng lập thế giới.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Vua sẽ nói với những người ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hãy đến, hỡi những người được Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban phước! Vương quốc đã được chuẩn bị sẵn cho các người từ khi sáng tạo thế giới; nay hãy nhận lấy làm cơ nghiệp.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Vua sẽ nói với những người ở bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hãy đến đây, hỡi những người được Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban phước! Hãy nhận lấy vương quốc làm của mình. Vương quốc ấy đã được chuẩn bị sẵn cho các người từ khi thế giới được dựng nên.

ko.L: 그때에 왕이 자기 오른쪽에 있는 사람들에게 말할 것이다. '오너라, 내 아버지의 복을 받은 사람들아. 세상의 기초가 놓일 때부터 너희를 위하여 준비된 나라를 상속하여라.
ko.B: 그때 왕이 자기 오른쪽에 있는 사람들에게 말할 것이다. '내 아버지께 복을 받은 사람들아, 오너라. 이 나라는 세상이 창조된 때부터 너희를 위하여 준비되어 있었다. 이제 이 나라를 물려받아라.
ko.R: 그때 왕이 자기 오른쪽에 있는 사람들에게 말할 것이다. '내 아버지께서 복을 주신 사람들아, 오너라! 이 나라를 너희 것으로 받아라. 이 나라는 세상이 만들어진 때부터 너희를 위하여 준비되어 기다리고 있었다.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ በቀኙ ያሉትን እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ በአባቴ የተባረካችሁ፣ ኑ፤ ከዓለም መመሥረት ጀምሮ ለእናንተ የተዘጋጀችውን መንግሥት ውረሱ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ በቀኙ ያሉትን እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ አባቴ የባረካችሁ፣ ኑ። ለእናንተ የተዘጋጀችው መንግሥት ዓለም ከተመሠረተ ጀምሮ ስትጠብቃችሁ ኖራለች፤ አሁን ውረሷት።
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ በቀኙ ያሉትን ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ አባቴ የባረካችሁ ሰዎች፣ ኑ! ይህችን መንግሥት የራሳችሁ አድርጋችሁ ተቀበሉ። ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ተዘጋጅታ ስትጠብቃችሁ ቆይታለች።

decisions.choice: the King: the Son of Man himself
decisions.reason: The King speaks of "my Father", so he is the Son of Man of 25:31, now named as king (compare 2:2; 27:11).

decisions.choice: inherit: receive as a gift that belongs to God's children
decisions.reason: An inheritance is not earned. The kingdom was prepared for them long before they acted.

decisions.choice: from the foundation of the world: from the beginning of creation
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in 13:35. God's plan for his people was made before history began.

decisions.choice: King, with a capital
decisions.reason: The title belongs to the Son of Man himself, so it is capitalized, and his pronouns take the usual span.

decisions.choice: Receive the kingdom as your own
decisions.reason: Readable says what inheriting means without the legal word.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans in the King's words to both groups (vengan|venid, reciban|recibid, ustedes|vosotros)
decisions.reason: The King speaks to many people at once, so every plural "you" from here to 25:45 is the ustedes / vosotros setting, a choice English does not have.

decisions.choice: le Roi, with a capital; héritez du royaume (L), il vous revient en héritage (B), Recevez le royaume, il est à vous (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: the title belongs to the Son of Man. Readable says what inheriting means without the legal word (m2).

decisions.choice: "Vua", with a capital
decisions.reason: The King is the Son of Man himself (meaning decision); Vietnamese capitalises the title as the English does, and it takes no setting span.

decisions.choice: "các người" for the gathered nations, both on the right and on the left (25:34-45)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must choose how the King speaks to the peoples before his throne; "các người" is the neutral plural the style guide gives for crowds, and the same word for both groups keeps the two speeches parallel, as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: "왕" with no honorific in Jesus' telling
decisions.reason: The King is the Son of Man himself (meaning decision); Korean has no capital to mark it, and Jesus does not honour himself, so the title stands plainly.

decisions.choice: "상속하다" (L); "물려받다" (B); "너희 것으로 받다" (R); "세상의 기초가 놓일 때부터" (L)
decisions.reason: Inherit means receive as a gift that belongs to God's children (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Greek picture of the world's foundation, the others say "since the world was made".

source.text: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ ἐποτίσατέ με, ξένος ἤμην καὶ συνηγάγετέ με, γυμνὸς καὶ περιεβάλετέ με, ἠσθένησα καὶ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με, ἐν φυλακῇ ἤμην καὶ ἤλθατε πρός με.

records.literal_gloss: I hungered for and you gave me to eat, I thirsted and you gave drink me, a stranger I was and you took in me, \v 36 naked and you clothed me, I was sick and you visited me, in prison I was and you came to me.

en.L: For I was hungry and you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [something] to eat, I was thirsty and you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} drink, I was a stranger and you took {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in, \v 36 naked and you clothed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I was sick and you visited {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, I was in prison and you came to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.B: For when I was hungry, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} food; when I was thirsty, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a drink; when I was a stranger, you took {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} into your home; \v 36 when I had no clothes, you dressed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; when I was sick, you looked after {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; when I was in prison, you came to see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.R: When I was hungry, you fed {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. When I was thirsty, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} water. When I was a stranger, you let {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} stay with you. \v 36 When I had no clothes, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} clothes to wear. When I was sick, you took care of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. When I was in prison, you came to visit {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'

es.L: Porque tuve hambre y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} [algo] de comer, tuve sed y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} de beber, era extranjero y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:acogieron|acogisteis}}, \v 36 [estaba] desnudo y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:vistieron|vestisteis}}, estuve enfermo y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:visitaron|visitasteis}}, estaba en la cárcel y {{plural_you:vinieron|vinisteis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”.
es.B: Porque cuando tuve hambre, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} comida; cuando tuve sed, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} de beber; cuando era forastero, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa; \v 36 cuando no tenía ropa, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:vistieron|vestisteis}}; cuando estuve enfermo, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:cuidaron|cuidasteis}}; cuando estuve en la cárcel, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} a ver”.
es.R: Cuando tuve hambre, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} de comer. Cuando tuve sed, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} agua. Cuando era forastero, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:invitaron|invitasteis}} a quedarme en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa. \v 36 Cuando no tenía ropa, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} ropa. Cuando estuve enfermo, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:cuidaron|cuidasteis}}. Cuando estuve en la cárcel, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} a visitar”.

fr.L: Car j’ai eu faim et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez donné à manger, j’ai eu soif et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez donné à boire, j’étais étranger et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez accueilli, \v 36 nu, et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez vêtu, j’ai été malade et vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez visité, j’étais en prison et vous êtes venus à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.”
fr.B: Car lorsque j’avais faim, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez donné à manger ; lorsque j’avais soif, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez donné à boire ; lorsque j’étais étranger, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez reçu chez vous ; \v 36 lorsque j’étais sans vêtements, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez habillé ; lorsque j’étais malade, vous avez pris soin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; lorsque j’étais en prison, vous êtes venus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} voir.”
fr.R: Quand j’avais faim, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez nourri. Quand j’avais soif, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez donné de l’eau. Quand j’étais un étranger, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez reçu chez vous. \v 36 Quand je n’avais pas de vêtements, vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en avez donné. Quand j’étais malade, vous vous êtes occupés de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Quand j’étais en prison, vous êtes venus {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} voir.”

sw.L: Kwa maana niliona njaa nanyi mkanipa [kitu] cha kula, niliona kiu nanyi mkanipa cha kunywa, nilikuwa mgeni nanyi mkanipokea, \v 36 [nilikuwa] uchi nanyi mkanivalisha, niliugua nanyi mkanitembelea, nilikuwa gerezani nanyi mkaja {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.'
sw.B: Kwa maana nilipokuwa na njaa, mlinipa chakula; nilipokuwa na kiu, mlinipa maji ya kunywa; nilipokuwa mgeni, mlinikaribisha nyumbani kwenu; \v 36 nilipokuwa sina nguo, mlinivalisha; nilipokuwa mgonjwa, mlinihudumia; nilipokuwa gerezani, mlikuja kuniona.'
sw.R: Nilipokuwa na njaa, mlinilisha. Nilipokuwa na kiu, mlinipa maji. Nilipokuwa mgeni, mliniruhusu nikae kwenu. \v 36 Nilipokuwa sina nguo, mlinipa nguo za kuvaa. Nilipokuwa mgonjwa, mlinitunza. Nilipokuwa gerezani, mlikuja kunitembelea.'

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói và các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát và các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} uống, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là khách lạ và các người đã tiếp rước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \v 36 {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trần truồng và các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mặc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau ốm và các người đã thăm viếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trong ngục và các người đã đến với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Vì khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} uống; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là khách lạ, các người đã tiếp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào nhà; \v 36 khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không có áo mặc, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mặc; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau ốm, các người đã chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trong ngục, các người đã đến thăm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nước uống. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là người lạ, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với mình. \v 36 Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không có quần áo, các người đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} quần áo để mặc. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau ốm, các người đã chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở trong tù, các người đã đến thăm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 내가 굶주렸을 때에 너희가 나에게 [무엇을] 먹게 해 주었고, 내가 목말랐을 때에 너희가 나에게 마실 것을 주었고, 내가 나그네였을 때에 너희가 나를 맞아들였고, \v 36 헐벗었을 때에 너희가 나에게 옷을 입혀 주었고, 내가 병들었을 때에 너희가 나를 돌보아 주었고, 내가 감옥에 있었을 때에 너희가 나에게 찾아왔기 때문이다.'
ko.B: 너희는 내가 굶주렸을 때에 먹을 것을 주었고, 목말랐을 때에 마실 것을 주었고, 나그네였을 때에 너희 집에 맞아들였다. \v 36 내가 헐벗었을 때에 옷을 입혀 주었고, 병들었을 때에 돌보아 주었고, 감옥에 갇혔을 때에 찾아와 주었다.'
ko.R: 내가 배고팠을 때에 너희는 나에게 먹을 것을 주었다. 내가 목말랐을 때에 마실 물을 주었다. 내가 낯선 나그네였을 때에 너희 집에서 묵게 해 주었다. \v 36 내가 입을 옷이 없었을 때에 옷을 주었다. 내가 아팠을 때에 돌보아 주었다. 내가 감옥에 있었을 때에 찾아와 주었다.'

am.L: ተርቤ ነበርና አበላችሁኝ፤ ተጠምቼ ነበር፣ አጠጣችሁኝም፤ እንግዳ ነበርኩ፣ ተቀበላችሁኝም፤ \v 36 ታርዤ [ነበር]፣ አለበሳችሁኝም፤ ታምሜ ነበር፣ ጠየቃችሁኝም፤ በእስር ቤት ነበርኩ፣ ወደ እኔም መጣችሁ።”
am.B: ምክንያቱም ተርቤ ሳለሁ አበላችሁኝ፤ ተጠምቼ ሳለሁ አጠጣችሁኝ፤ እንግዳ ሆኜ ሳለሁ ወደ ቤታችሁ ተቀበላችሁኝ፤ \v 36 ልብስ በሌለኝ ጊዜ አለበሳችሁኝ፤ ታምሜ ሳለሁ ተንከባከባችሁኝ፤ ታስሬ ሳለሁ መጥታችሁ ጠየቃችሁኝ።”
am.R: በተራብኩ ጊዜ አበላችሁኝ። በተጠማሁ ጊዜ ውኃ አጠጣችሁኝ። እንግዳ በነበርኩ ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳርፍ ፈቀዳችሁልኝ። \v 36 ልብስ ባልነበረኝ ጊዜ የምለብሰው ልብስ ሰጣችሁኝ። በታመምኩ ጊዜ ተንከባከባችሁኝ። በእስር ቤት በነበርኩ ጊዜ መጥታችሁ ጠየቃችሁኝ።”

decisions.choice: a stranger: a traveler or foreigner far from home who needs a place to stay
decisions.reason: Hospitality to strangers was a duty the law commanded (Leviticus 19:34). To take in means to receive into one's home.

decisions.choice: naked: without enough clothing
decisions.reason: The word is used of someone poorly clothed as well as of someone with no clothes.

decisions.choice: visited: came to help and care for
decisions.reason: The verb means to look after someone in need.

decisions.choice: I was hungry: the King names himself in those who were in need
decisions.reason: The righteous are surprised by this (25:37-39), and the King explains it in 25:40.

decisions.choice: me with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The King is the Son of Man speaking of himself, so "me" takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: "khách lạ" (L, B), "người lạ" (R); "trần truồng" (L), "không có áo mặc" (B), "không có quần áo" (R)
decisions.reason: A stranger is a traveler far from home who needs a place to stay, and "naked" means without enough clothing (meaning decisions); Literal keeps the Greek word, Balanced and Readable say the need.

decisions.choice: "내가 ...했을 때에 너희가 ..." for each pair; "... 때문이다" closing the list (L)
decisions.reason: Korean links each need to the deed with "-을 때에", which keeps the Greek pairs in order; Literal closes the whole list with "때문이다" for the Greek "for".

decisions.choice: [무엇을] (L)
decisions.reason: Korean needs an object for "gave me to eat"; Literal brackets it.

source.text: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται αὐτῷ οἱ δίκαιοι λέγοντες· Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα καὶ ἐθρέψαμεν, ἢ διψῶντα καὶ ἐποτίσαμεν;

records.literal_gloss: Then will answer him the righteous saying: Lord, when you did we see hungering and fed, or thirsting and gave drink?

en.L: Then the righteous will answer {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, 'Lord, when did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry and feed [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}], or thirsty and give [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] drink?
en.B: Then the righteous will reply, 'Lord, when was it that we saw {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry and fed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, or thirsty and gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a drink?
en.R: Then the righteous people will answer, 'Lord, when did we ever see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry and give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} food? When did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thirsty and give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} something to drink?

es.L: Entonces {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} responderán los justos, diciendo: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos hambriento y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] alimentamos, o sediento y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] dimos de beber?
es.B: Entonces los justos responderán: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos con hambre y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dimos de comer, o con sed y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dimos de beber?
es.R: Entonces los justos contestarán: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos con hambre y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dimos comida? ¿Cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos con sed y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dimos algo de beber?

fr.L: Alors les justes {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} répondront, disant : “Seigneur, quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu ayant faim et [{{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}]avons-nous nourri, ou ayant soif et [{{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}]avons-nous donné à boire ?
fr.B: Alors les justes répondront : “Seigneur, quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu affamé et {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous nourri, ou assoiffé et {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous donné à boire ?
fr.R: Alors les justes répondront : “Seigneur, quand est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons vu avoir faim, et que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons donné à manger ? Quand est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons vu avoir soif, et que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons donné à boire ?

sw.L: Wakati huo wenye haki watamjibu, wakisema, 'Bwana, tulikuona lini ukiwa na njaa tukakupa chakula, au ukiwa na kiu tukakupa cha kunywa?
sw.B: Kisha wenye haki watajibu, 'Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa tukakupa chakula, au ukiwa na kiu tukakupa maji ya kunywa?
sw.R: Kisha watu wenye haki watajibu, 'Bwana, ni lini tuliwahi kukuona ukiwa na njaa tukakupa chakula? Ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na kiu tukakupa kitu cha kunywa?

vi.L: Bấy giờ những người công chính sẽ trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rằng: 'Lạy Chúa, có khi nào chúng con thấy Chúa đói mà cho ăn, hoặc khát mà cho uống?
vi.B: Bấy giờ những người công chính sẽ thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, có bao giờ chúng con thấy Chúa đói mà cho Chúa ăn, hoặc khát mà cho Chúa uống đâu?
vi.R: Bấy giờ những người công chính sẽ thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, có bao giờ chúng con thấy Chúa đói và cho Chúa ăn đâu? Có bao giờ chúng con thấy Chúa khát và cho Chúa uống đâu?

ko.L: 그때에 의인들이 그에게 대답하여 말할 것이다. '주님, 언제 저희가 주님께서 굶주리신 것을 보고 [주님을] 먹여 드렸으며, 목마르신 것을 보고 [주님께] 마실 것을 드렸습니까?
ko.B: 그러면 의인들이 대답할 것이다. '주님, 저희가 언제 주님께서 굶주리신 것을 보고 잡수실 것을 드렸으며, 언제 목마르신 것을 보고 마실 것을 드렸습니까?
ko.R: 그러면 의로운 사람들이 대답할 것이다. '주님, 저희가 언제 주님께서 배고프신 것을 보고 음식을 드렸습니까? 언제 주님께서 목마르신 것을 보고 마실 것을 드렸습니까?

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃን እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሱለታል፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ መቼ ተርበህ አይተንህ አበላንህ? ወይስ ተጠምተህ አጠጣንህ?
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃኑ እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሱለታል፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ ተርበህ አይተንህ ያበላንህ፣ ወይም ተጠምተህ አይተንህ ያጠጣንህ መቼ ነው?
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃን ሰዎች እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሱለታል፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ መቼ ተርበህ አይተንህ ምግብ ሰጠንህ? መቼስ ተጠምተህ አይተንህ የምትጠጣው ሰጠንህ?

decisions.choice: the righteous: those who do what is right in God's eyes
decisions.reason: The word describes those on the King's right. Their surprise shows they did not act to earn a reward.

decisions.choice: when did we see you: a real question of surprise
decisions.reason: They did not know that they were serving the King.

decisions.choice: him, you with deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: They speak to the King, the Son of Man, so "you" takes the usual span.

decisions.choice: les justes at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for the righteous; it stays at Readable too, since the English Readable keeps "righteous" and the word returns in 25:46.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa", "Chúa" for "you" and "chúng con" for "we", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Those who call him Lord speak to him as "Chúa", a noun of address that takes no setting (style guide, section 6), and of themselves as "chúng con", as in 7:22.

decisions.choice: The righteous speak to the King in 합쇼체 with "주님" for "you" and the humble "저희" (25:37-39, 44)
decisions.reason: Korean does not say "you" to a king; kyrie is "주님" in the Korean Matthew, and those who address him use honorifics on his every act ("굶주리신", "잡수실").

decisions.choice: "의인들" (L, B); "의로운 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: "의인" is the Korean Matthew's word (13:43); Readable spells it out.

source.text: πότε δέ σε εἴδομεν ξένον καὶ συνηγάγομεν, ἢ γυμνὸν καὶ περιεβάλομεν;

records.literal_gloss: When now you did we see a stranger and took in, or naked and clothed?

en.L: And when did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a stranger and take [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] in, or naked and clothe [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}]?
en.B: When was it that we saw {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} a stranger and welcomed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in, or without clothes and dressed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.R: When did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} as a stranger and invite {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} into our homes? When did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} without clothes and give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} clothes to wear?

es.L: ¿Y cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos extranjero y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] acogimos, o desnudo y [{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}] vestimos?
es.B: ¿Cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos forastero y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} recibimos en casa, o sin ropa y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vestimos?
es.R: ¿Cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos como forastero y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} invitamos a nuestra casa? ¿Cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos sin ropa y {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dimos ropa?

fr.L: Et quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu étranger et [{{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}]avons-nous accueilli, ou nu et [{{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}]avons-nous vêtu ?
fr.B: Quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu étranger et {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous accueilli chez nous, ou sans vêtements et {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous habillé ?
fr.R: Quand est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons vu étranger, et que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons invité chez nous ? Quand est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons vu sans vêtements, et que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en avons donné ?

sw.L: Na ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakupokea, au uchi tukakuvalisha?
sw.B: Ni lini tulikuona ukiwa mgeni tukakukaribisha nyumbani, au huna nguo tukakuvalisha?

ko.L: 그리고 언제 저희가 주님께서 나그네 되신 것을 보고 [주님을] 맞아들였으며, 헐벗으신 것을 보고 [주님께] 옷을 입혀 드렸습니까?

ko.R: 언제 주님께서 낯선 나그네로 오신 것을 보고 저희 집에 모셨습니까? 언제 주님께서 입을 옷이 없으신 것을 보고 옷을 드렸습니까?

am.L: መቼስ እንግዳ ሆነህ አይተንህ ተቀበልንህ? ወይስ ታርዘህ አለበስንህ?
am.B: እንግዳ ሆነህ አይተንህ ወደ ቤታችን የተቀበልንህ፣ ወይም ልብስ አጥተህ አይተንህ ያለበስንህ መቼ ነው?
am.R: መቼ እንግዳ ሆነህ አይተንህ ወደ ቤታችን ጋበዝንህ? መቼስ ልብስ አጥተህ አይተንህ የምትለብሰው ሰጠንህ?

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐρεῖ αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ’ ὅσον ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν ἐλαχίστων, ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

records.literal_gloss: And answering the King will say to them: Truly I say to you, to the extent that you did to one of these the brothers of me the least, to me you did.

en.L: And the King will answer and say to them, 'Truly I tell you, as much as you did [it] to one of the least of these {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, you did [it] to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.B: The King will answer them, 'Truly I tell you, each time you did it for one of these {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, even the least of them, you did it for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.R: And the King will answer, 'I tell you the truth, whenever you did these things for even the least important of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, you were doing them for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'

es.L: Y respondiendo el Rey, les dirá: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo cuanto {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} a uno de estos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos, los más pequeños, a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [lo] {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}}”.
es.B: El Rey les responderá: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que cada vez que lo {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} por uno de estos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos, aun el más pequeño de ellos, lo {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”.
es.R: Y el Rey contestará: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: cada vez que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} estas cosas por el menos importante de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} hermanos, las {{plural_you:estaban|estabais}} haciendo por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”.

fr.L: Et le Roi, répondant, leur dira : “En vérité, je vous le dis : dans la mesure où vous [l’]avez fait à l’un de ces plus petits de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, c’est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous [l’]avez fait.”
fr.B: Le Roi leur répondra : “En vérité, je vous le dis : chaque fois que vous l’avez fait pour l’un de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} que voici, même pour le plus petit d’entre eux, c’est pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous l’avez fait.”
fr.R: Et le Roi répondra : “Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : chaque fois que vous avez fait cela pour le moins important de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, c’est pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous l’avez fait.”

sw.L: Na Mfalme, akijibu, atawaambia, 'Kweli nawaambia, kila mlichomfanyia mmoja wa hawa ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, hata aliye mdogo kuliko wote, mlinifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.'
sw.B: Mfalme atawajibu, 'Kweli nawaambia, kila mara mlipomfanyia jambo hilo mmoja wa hawa ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, hata yule mdogo kuliko wote, mlinifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.'
sw.R: Mfalme atajibu, 'Nawaambia ukweli: kila mlipomfanyia mambo haya hata yule asiye na umuhimu kati ya ndugu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, mlikuwa mkinifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.'

vi.L: Và Vua sẽ đáp lời và nói với họ: 'Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, khi các người đã làm [điều đó] cho một người trong những {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} hèn mọn nhất này của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là các người đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Vua sẽ đáp: 'Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, mỗi khi các người làm điều đó cho một người trong những {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} này của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù là người nhỏ bé nhất, là các người đã làm cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Vua sẽ trả lời: 'Ta nói thật với các người, mỗi khi các người làm những việc ấy cho một người trong những {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù là người nhỏ bé nhất, là các người đã làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 그러면 왕이 대답하여 그들에게 말할 것이다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 여기 있는 내 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 가운데 가장 작은 사람 하나에게 [그것을] 한 만큼, 너희가 나에게 [그것을] 한 것이다.'
ko.B: 왕이 그들에게 대답할 것이다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 여기 있는 내 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 가운데 하나에게, 그것도 가장 작은 사람 하나에게 이 일을 할 때마다, 그것은 곧 나에게 한 것이다.'
ko.R: 왕이 대답할 것이다. '내가 분명히 말한다. 너희가 내 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 가운데 가장 보잘것없는 사람에게 이런 일을 할 때마다, 너희는 그 일을 나에게 한 것이다.'

am.L: ንጉሡም መልሶ እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ ከእነዚህ ከሁሉ ከሚያንሱት {{gender:ከወንድሞቼና ከእኅቶቼ|ከወንድሞቼ}} ለአንዱ ያደረጋችሁትን ሁሉ ለእኔ አደረጋችሁት።”
am.B: ንጉሡም እንዲህ ብሎ ይመልስላቸዋል፦ “እውነት እላችኋለሁ፣ ከእነዚህ {{gender:ከወንድሞቼና ከእኅቶቼ|ከወንድሞቼ}} ለአንዱ፣ ከሁሉም ለሚያንሰው እንኳ፣ ባደረጋችሁለት ቁጥር ለእኔ አደረጋችሁት።”
am.R: ንጉሡም እንዲህ ብሎ ይመልስላቸዋል፦ “እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፣ እነዚህን ነገሮች {{gender:ከወንድሞቼና ከእኅቶቼ|ከወንድሞቼ}} መካከል ከሁሉም ዝቅተኛ ለሆነው እንኳ ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ ለእኔ ማድረጋችሁ ነበር።”

decisions.choice: the least of these my brothers: Jesus's followers in need
alternatives: anyone in need, believer or not
decisions.reason: Jesus calls his disciples his brothers (12:49-50; 28:10) and promises that whoever helps one of these little ones will be rewarded (10:40-42). Others read the words of every needy person, since the King names himself in all who suffer. The passage does not settle it.

decisions.choice: brothers: men and women alike
decisions.reason: The word in the plural often means brothers and sisters together (12:50).

decisions.choice: you did it to me: what is done to them is done to the King himself
alternatives: only counted as if it were done to him
decisions.reason: Jesus identifies himself with his brothers, as in 10:40: "Whoever welcomes you welcomes me."

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The word includes women, so the inclusive form is the default and the traditional form is the alternative.

decisions.choice: Truly I tell you (L, B); I tell you the truth (R)
decisions.reason: As in 25:12, the solemn opening keeps the settled wording.

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used through Matthew; it covers 25:45.

decisions.choice: hermanos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has "brothers and sisters|brothers" (meaning decision m2). Spanish "hermanos" already includes sisters, so it stays plain, as the term sheet settles for the whole New Testament.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}; En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B), Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: the word includes women (m2), so the inclusive form is the default and "frères" the alternative. "Le plus petit" agrees with the noun and is generic, so it needs no span.

decisions.choice: Kweli nawaambia (L, B); Nawaambia ukweli (R)
decisions.reason: The rendering of the single "amen" used through Matthew; it covers 25:45.

decisions.choice: ndugu, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has "brothers and sisters|brothers" (meaning decision m2). Swahili "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so no setting applies.

decisions.choice: {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}
decisions.reason: The style guide's span for brothers meaning men and women alike (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các người" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các người" (R); "hèn mọn nhất" (L), "nhỏ bé nhất" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Gospels' form for "Truly I tell you", recorded once for this passage (also 25:45), with the King's "các người".

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들
decisions.reason: The settled Korean span for adelphoi meaning men and women alike (meaning decision), as in the Korean Matthew 12:50 and 23:8; the plural ending stands outside it.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R) in the King's mouth
decisions.reason: The King uses Jesus' own formula; the settled words keep it.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ከወንድሞቼና ከእኅቶቼ|ከወንድሞቼ}}
decisions.reason: The King's "brothers" are his followers, men and women alike (meaning decision m2). Amharic has both wordings, so the setting gives "my brothers and sisters" by default and "my brothers" as the alternative; the prefix "ከ-" goes inside each option.

decisions.choice: "እውነት እላችኋለሁ" (L, B); "እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ" (R)
decisions.reason: The solemn "amen" before a saying is given its meaning, the book-wide choice; the same in 25:45.

source.text: τότε ἐρεῖ καὶ τοῖς ἐξ εὐωνύμων· Πορεύεσθε ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ οἱ κατηραμένοι εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ αἰώνιον τὸ ἡτοιμασμένον τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Then he will say also to those on left: Depart from me those having been cursed into the fire the eternal the having been prepared for the devil and the angels of him.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say also to those on [the] left, 'Depart from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say to those at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left, 'Go away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you who are under a curse, into the eternal fire that has been made ready for the devil and his angels.
en.R: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say to the people on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} left, 'Go away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, you people who are under a curse! Go into the eternal fire. It was made ready for the devil and his angels.

es.L: Entonces dirá también a los de [la] izquierda: “{{plural_you:Márchense|Marchaos}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los malditos, al fuego eterno que ha sido preparado para el diablo y sus ángeles.
es.B: Entonces dirá a los que estén a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda: “{{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que están|vosotros que estáis}} bajo maldición, al fuego eterno que ha sido preparado para el diablo y sus ángeles.
es.R: Entonces dirá a la gente que está a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} izquierda: “¡{{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que están|vosotros que estáis}} bajo maldición! {{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} al fuego eterno. Fue preparado para el diablo y sus ángeles.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira aussi à ceux qui sont à gauche : “Retirez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, maudits, [allez] dans le feu éternel préparé pour le diable et ses anges.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira à ceux qui seront à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche : “Allez-vous-en loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous qui êtes sous la malédiction, dans le feu éternel qui a été préparé pour le diable et ses anges.
fr.R: Ensuite, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira aux gens qui sont à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gauche : “Allez-vous-en loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, vous qui êtes maudits ! Allez dans le feu éternel. Il a été préparé pour le diable et ses anges.

sw.L: Kisha atasema pia kwa wale walio upande wa kushoto, 'Ondokeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ninyi mliolaaniwa, mwende katika moto ule wa milele ulioandaliwa kwa ajili ya Ibilisi na malaika zake.
sw.B: Kisha atawaambia wale walio upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, 'Ondokeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ninyi mlio chini ya laana, mwende kwenye moto wa milele ambao umeandaliwa kwa ajili ya Ibilisi na malaika zake.
sw.R: Kisha atawaambia watu walio upande wa kushoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, 'Ondokeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ninyi mlio chini ya laana! Nendeni kwenye moto wa milele. Uliandaliwa kwa ajili ya Ibilisi na malaika zake.

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng sẽ nói với những người ở bên trái: 'Hỡi những kẻ bị rủa sả, hãy lui ra khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà vào lửa đời đời đã chuẩn bị cho ma quỷ và các thiên sứ của nó.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói với những người ở bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hỡi những kẻ bị rủa sả, hãy đi khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà vào lửa đời đời, là lửa đã được chuẩn bị cho ma quỷ và các thiên sứ của nó.
vi.R: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nói với những người ở bên trái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: 'Hỡi những kẻ bị rủa sả, hãy đi khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Hãy vào lửa đời đời. Lửa ấy đã được chuẩn bị cho ma quỷ và các thiên sứ của nó.

ko.L: 그때에 그는 왼쪽에 있는 사람들에게도 말할 것이다. '저주받은 사람들아, 나에게서 떠나, 마귀와 그의 천사들을 위하여 준비된 영원한 불 속으로 들어가거라.
ko.B: 그때 그는 자기 왼쪽에 있는 사람들에게도 말할 것이다. '저주를 받은 사람들아, 나에게서 물러가라. 마귀와 그 부하들을 위하여 마련된 영원한 불 속으로 들어가거라.
ko.R: 그때 그는 자기 왼쪽에 있는 사람들에게 말할 것이다. '저주를 받은 사람들아, 나에게서 떠나가라! 영원한 불 속으로 들어가거라. 그 불은 마귀와 그 부하들을 위하여 마련된 것이다.

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ በግራ ያሉትንም ደግሞ እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ የተረገማችሁ፣ ከእኔ ተለይታችሁ ለዲያብሎስና ለመላእክቱ ወደ ተዘጋጀው ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ሂዱ።
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ በግራው ያሉትን እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ ርግማን ያለባችሁ፣ ከእኔ ራቁ፤ ለዲያብሎስና ለመላእክቱ ወደ ተዘጋጀው ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ሂዱ።
am.R: ከዚያም በግራው ያሉትን ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላቸዋል፦ “እናንተ የተረገማችሁ ሰዎች፣ ከእኔ ራቁ! ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ሂዱ። ያ እሳት ለዲያብሎስና ለመላእክቱ የተዘጋጀ ነው።

decisions.choice: depart from me: as in 7:23
decisions.reason: The King uses the words of 7:23, which echo Psalm 6:8.

decisions.choice: cursed, and a fire prepared for the devil: not prepared for them
alternatives: cursed by the Father, a fire made for people
decisions.reason: The blessed are blessed "of my Father" and the kingdom was prepared for them (25:34). Here neither is said: the curse is not called the Father's, and the fire was prepared for the devil and his angels.

decisions.choice: eternal: belonging to the age to come, without end
decisions.reason: The same word describes both the punishment and the life in 25:46.

decisions.choice: Depart (L); Go away (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 7:23, Literal keeps "depart" and Balanced and Readable use everyday words.

decisions.choice: he, me with deity_pronoun spans; his angels with none
alternatives: a span on the devil's angels
decisions.reason: The King's pronouns take the span. "His angels" are the devil's.

decisions.choice: Retirez-vous de moi (L); Allez-vous-en loin de moi (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English "depart" and "go away". Literal brackets "[allez]" because French cannot attach "dans le feu" to "retirez-vous".

decisions.choice: "bị rủa sả"; "lửa đời đời"; "ma quỷ"; "nó" for the devil
decisions.reason: "Ma quỷ" is the settled word for the devil; "đời đời" is the word of "sự sống đời đời" (25:46), so the two ends are heard together; the devil's angels are "các thiên sứ của nó", with the plain pronoun the English leaves without a span.

decisions.choice: "나에게서 떠나" (L); "물러가라" (B); "떠나가라" (R)
decisions.reason: The command echoes 7:23 (meaning decision), where the Korean Matthew has "물러가라" (L) and "떠나가라" (B); the levels keep those words, Literal joining the clauses as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: "그의 천사들" (L); "그 부하들" (B, R) for the devil's angels
decisions.reason: Korean "천사" names God's angels; Balanced and Readable say the devil's messengers are his underlings, so no reader mistakes them for God's. The English gives the devil's "his" no span.

source.text: ἐπείνασα γὰρ καὶ οὐκ ἐδώκατέ μοι φαγεῖν, ἐδίψησα καὶ οὐκ ἐποτίσατέ με, ξένος ἤμην καὶ οὐ συνηγάγετέ με, γυμνὸς καὶ οὐ περιεβάλετέ με, ἀσθενὴς καὶ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐπεσκέψασθέ με.

records.literal_gloss: I hungered for and not you gave me to eat, I thirsted and not you gave drink me, \v 43 a stranger I was and not you took in me, naked and not you clothed me, sick and in prison and not you visited me.

en.L: For I was hungry and you did not give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [anything] to eat, I was thirsty and you did not give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} drink, \v 43 I was a stranger and you did not take {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in, naked and you did not clothe {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, sick and in prison and you did not visit {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.B: For when I was hungry, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} no food; when I was thirsty, you gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} nothing to drink; \v 43 when I was a stranger, you did not take {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} into your home; when I had no clothes, you did not dress {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; when I was sick and in prison, you did not look after {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.R: When I was hungry, you did not give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} food. When I was thirsty, you did not give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} water. \v 43 When I was a stranger, you did not let {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} stay with you. When I had no clothes, you did not give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} clothes to wear. When I was sick and in prison, you did not come to take care of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'

es.L: Porque tuve hambre y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} [nada] de comer, tuve sed y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} de beber, \v 43 era extranjero y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:acogieron|acogisteis}}, [estaba] desnudo y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:vistieron|vestisteis}}, enfermo y en la cárcel y no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:visitaron|visitasteis}}”.
es.B: Porque cuando tuve hambre, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} comida; cuando tuve sed, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} nada de beber; \v 43 cuando era forastero, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa; cuando no tenía ropa, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:vistieron|vestisteis}}; cuando estuve enfermo y en la cárcel, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:cuidaron|cuidasteis}}”.
es.R: Cuando tuve hambre, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} de comer. Cuando tuve sed, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} agua. \v 43 Cuando era forastero, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:invitaron|invitasteis}} a quedarme en {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} casa. Cuando no tenía ropa, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} ropa. Cuando estuve enfermo y en la cárcel, no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} a cuidar”.

fr.L: Car j’ai eu faim et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas donné à manger, j’ai eu soif et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas donné à boire, \v 43 j’étais étranger et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas accueilli, nu, et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas vêtu, malade et en prison, et vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas visité.”
fr.B: Car lorsque j’avais faim, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas donné à manger ; lorsque j’avais soif, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez rien donné à boire ; \v 43 lorsque j’étais étranger, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas reçu chez vous ; lorsque j’étais sans vêtements, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas habillé ; lorsque j’étais malade et en prison, vous n’avez pas pris soin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.”
fr.R: Quand j’avais faim, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas nourri. Quand j’avais soif, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas donné d’eau. \v 43 Quand j’étais un étranger, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez pas reçu chez vous. Quand je n’avais pas de vêtements, vous ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}en avez pas donné. Quand j’étais malade et en prison, vous n’êtes pas venus vous occuper de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.”

sw.L: Kwa maana niliona njaa nanyi hamkunipa [kitu] cha kula, niliona kiu nanyi hamkunipa cha kunywa, \v 43 nilikuwa mgeni nanyi hamkunipokea, [nilikuwa] uchi nanyi hamkunivalisha, mgonjwa na gerezani nanyi hamkunitembelea.'
sw.B: Kwa maana nilipokuwa na njaa, hamkunipa chakula; nilipokuwa na kiu, hamkunipa maji ya kunywa; \v 43 nilipokuwa mgeni, hamkunikaribisha nyumbani kwenu; nilipokuwa sina nguo, hamkunivalisha; nilipokuwa mgonjwa na gerezani, hamkunihudumia.'
sw.R: Nilipokuwa na njaa, hamkunilisha. Nilipokuwa na kiu, hamkunipa maji. \v 43 Nilipokuwa mgeni, hamkuniruhusu nikae kwenu. Nilipokuwa sina nguo, hamkunipa nguo za kuvaa. Nilipokuwa mgonjwa na gerezani, hamkuja kunitunza.'

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói và các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát và các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} uống, \v 43 {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là khách lạ và các người đã không tiếp rước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trần truồng và các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mặc, đau ốm và ở trong ngục và các người đã không thăm viếng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Vì khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} uống; \v 43 khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là khách lạ, các người đã không tiếp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào nhà; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không có áo mặc, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mặc; khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau ốm và ở trong ngục, các người đã không chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ăn. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khát, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nước uống. \v 43 Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là người lạ, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với mình. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không có quần áo, các người đã không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} quần áo để mặc. Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đau ốm và ở trong tù, các người đã không đến chăm sóc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 내가 굶주렸을 때에 너희가 나에게 [아무것도] 먹게 해 주지 않았고, 내가 목말랐을 때에 너희가 나에게 마실 것을 주지 않았고, \v 43 내가 나그네였을 때에 너희가 나를 맞아들이지 않았고, 헐벗었을 때에 너희가 나에게 옷을 입혀 주지 않았고, 병들고 감옥에 있었을 때에 너희가 나를 돌보아 주지 않았기 때문이다.'
ko.B: 너희는 내가 굶주렸을 때에 먹을 것을 주지 않았고, 목말랐을 때에 마실 것을 주지 않았다. \v 43 내가 나그네였을 때에 너희 집에 맞아들이지 않았고, 헐벗었을 때에 옷을 입혀 주지 않았고, 병들고 감옥에 갇혔을 때에 돌보아 주지 않았다.'
ko.R: 내가 배고팠을 때에 너희는 나에게 먹을 것을 주지 않았다. 내가 목말랐을 때에 마실 물을 주지 않았다. \v 43 내가 낯선 나그네였을 때에 너희 집에서 묵게 해 주지 않았다. 내가 입을 옷이 없었을 때에 옷을 주지 않았다. 내가 아프고 감옥에 있었을 때에 찾아와 돌보아 주지 않았다.'

am.L: ተርቤ ነበርና አላበላችሁኝም፤ ተጠምቼ ነበር፣ አላጠጣችሁኝም፤ \v 43 እንግዳ ነበርኩ፣ አልተቀበላችሁኝም፤ ታርዤ [ነበር]፣ አላለበሳችሁኝም፤ ታምሜ በእስር ቤትም [ነበርኩ]፣ አልጠየቃችሁኝም።”
am.B: ምክንያቱም ተርቤ ሳለሁ አላበላችሁኝም፤ ተጠምቼ ሳለሁ አላጠጣችሁኝም፤ \v 43 እንግዳ ሆኜ ሳለሁ ወደ ቤታችሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝም፤ ልብስ በሌለኝ ጊዜ አላለበሳችሁኝም፤ ታምሜና ታስሬ ሳለሁ አልተንከባከባችሁኝም።”
am.R: በተራብኩ ጊዜ አላበላችሁኝም። በተጠማሁ ጊዜ ውኃ አላጠጣችሁኝም። \v 43 እንግዳ በነበርኩ ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር እንዳርፍ አልፈቀዳችሁልኝም። ልብስ ባልነበረኝ ጊዜ የምለብሰው ልብስ አልሰጣችሁኝም። በታመምኩና በታሰርኩ ጊዜ መጥታችሁ አልተንከባከባችሁኝም።”

source.text: τότε ἀποκριθήσονται καὶ αὐτοὶ λέγοντες· Κύριε, πότε σε εἴδομεν πεινῶντα ἢ διψῶντα ἢ ξένον ἢ γυμνὸν ἢ ἀσθενῆ ἢ ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ οὐ διηκονήσαμέν σοι;

records.literal_gloss: Then will answer also they saying: Lord, when you did we see hungering or thirsting or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and not did minister to you?

en.L: Then they also will answer, saying, 'Lord, when did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not serve {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?'
en.B: Then they too will reply, 'Lord, when did we see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry or thirsty, a stranger or without clothes, sick or in prison, and not come to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help?'
en.R: Then these people will answer, 'Lord, when did we ever see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hungry or thirsty, or a stranger, or without clothes, or sick, or in prison, and not help {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?'

es.L: Entonces responderán también ellos, diciendo: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos hambriento, o sediento, o extranjero, o desnudo, o enfermo, o en la cárcel, y no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} servimos?”.
es.B: Entonces ellos también responderán: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos con hambre o con sed, forastero o sin ropa, enfermo o en la cárcel, y no acudimos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda?”.
es.R: Entonces esa gente contestará: “Señor, ¿cuándo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vimos alguna vez con hambre o con sed, o como forastero, o sin ropa, o enfermo, o en la cárcel, y no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ayudamos?”.

fr.L: Alors eux aussi répondront, disant : “Seigneur, quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu ayant faim, ou soif, ou étranger, ou nu, ou malade, ou en prison, et ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous pas servi ?”
fr.B: Alors eux aussi répondront : “Seigneur, quand {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons-nous vu affamé ou assoiffé, étranger ou sans vêtements, malade ou en prison, sans venir à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} aide ?”
fr.R: Alors ces gens répondront : “Seigneur, quand est-ce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons vu avoir faim ou soif, être un étranger, être sans vêtements, être malade ou en prison, sans {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aider ?”

sw.L: Kisha wao pia watajibu, wakisema, 'Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa, au kiu, au mgeni, au uchi, au mgonjwa, au gerezani, na hatukukuhudumia?'
sw.B: Kisha wao nao watajibu, 'Bwana, ni lini tulikuona ukiwa na njaa au kiu, ukiwa mgeni au huna nguo, ukiwa mgonjwa au gerezani, nasi hatukuja kukusaidia?'
sw.R: Kisha watu hao watajibu, 'Bwana, ni lini tuliwahi kukuona ukiwa na njaa, au kiu, au ukiwa mgeni, au huna nguo, au ukiwa mgonjwa, au gerezani, nasi hatukukusaidia?'

vi.L: Bấy giờ họ cũng sẽ trả lời rằng: 'Lạy Chúa, có khi nào chúng tôi thấy Chúa đói, hoặc khát, hoặc là khách lạ, hoặc trần truồng, hoặc đau ốm, hoặc ở trong ngục, mà không phục vụ Chúa đâu?'
vi.B: Bấy giờ họ cũng sẽ thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, có bao giờ chúng tôi thấy Chúa đói hay khát, là khách lạ hay không có áo mặc, đau ốm hay ở trong ngục, mà không giúp đỡ Chúa đâu?'
vi.R: Bấy giờ những người ấy sẽ thưa: 'Lạy Chúa, có bao giờ chúng tôi thấy Chúa đói, hay khát, hay là người lạ, hay không có quần áo, hay đau ốm, hay ở trong tù, mà không giúp Chúa đâu?'

ko.L: 그때에 그들도 대답하여 말할 것이다. '주님, 언제 저희가 주님께서 굶주리시거나 목마르시거나 나그네 되시거나 헐벗으시거나 병드시거나 감옥에 계신 것을 보고 주님을 섬기지 않았습니까?'
ko.B: 그러면 그들도 대답할 것이다. '주님, 저희가 언제 주님께서 굶주리시거나 목마르시거나, 나그네 되시거나 헐벗으시거나, 병드시거나 감옥에 갇히신 것을 보고 돕지 않았습니까?'
ko.R: 그러면 이 사람들도 대답할 것이다. '주님, 저희가 언제 주님께서 배고프시거나 목마르신 것을 보았습니까? 언제 주님께서 나그네로 오시거나, 입을 옷이 없으시거나, 아프시거나, 감옥에 갇히신 것을 보고도 돕지 않았습니까?'

am.L: በዚያን ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሳሉ፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ ተርበህ ወይም ተጠምተህ ወይም እንግዳ ሆነህ ወይም ታርዘህ ወይም ታምመህ ወይም በእስር ቤት ሆነህ መቼ አይተንህ አላገለገልንህም?”
am.B: በዚያን ጊዜ እነርሱም ደግሞ እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሳሉ፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ ተርበህ ወይም ተጠምተህ፣ እንግዳ ሆነህ ወይም ልብስ አጥተህ፣ ታምመህ ወይም ታስረህ አይተንህ ያልረዳንህ መቼ ነው?”
am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ እነዚህ ሰዎች እንዲህ ብለው ይመልሳሉ፦ “ጌታ ሆይ፣ መቼ ተርበህ ወይም ተጠምተህ፣ ወይም እንግዳ ሆነህ፣ ወይም ልብስ አጥተህ፣ ወይም ታምመህ፣ ወይም ታስረህ አይተንህ ሳንረዳህ ቀረን?”

decisions.choice: serve: meet the needs of
decisions.reason: The verb is used of all kinds of care, from serving food to providing for someone (27:55).

decisions.choice: when did we see you: they too are surprised
alternatives: an excuse that they would have helped
decisions.reason: Like the righteous, they did not know the King was in those in need.

decisions.choice: come to your help
decisions.reason: Balanced says what serving meant here; Literal keeps "serve".

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" for those on the left; "Lạy Chúa" and "Chúa" as for the righteous
decisions.reason: Vietnamese marks relationship in its pronouns: the righteous speak as the King's own ("chúng con", 25:37), while those he does not own (7:23) say the neutral "chúng tôi", though they too call him Lord.

decisions.choice: "섬기다" (L); "돕다" (B, R) for diakoneo
decisions.reason: Serve here means meet someone's needs (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "help", as the English does.

source.text: τότε ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτοῖς λέγων· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐφ’ ὅσον οὐκ ἐποιήσατε ἑνὶ τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων, οὐδὲ ἐμοὶ ἐποιήσατε.

records.literal_gloss: Then he will answer them saying: Truly I say to you, to the extent that not you did to one of these the least, neither to me you did.

en.L: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer them, saying, 'Truly I tell you, as much as you did not do [it] to one of the least of these, you did not do [it] to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} either.'
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reply, 'Truly I tell you, each time you failed to do it for one of these, even the least of them, you failed to do it for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.R: Then the King will answer, 'I tell you the truth, when you did not do these things for even the least important of these, you did not do them for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'

es.L: Entonces les responderá, diciendo: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo cuanto no {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} a uno de estos, los más pequeños, tampoco a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [lo] {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}}”.
es.B: Entonces les responderá: “En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que cada vez que no lo {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} por uno de estos, aun el más pequeño de ellos, tampoco lo {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”.
es.R: Entonces el Rey contestará: “{{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: cuando no {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} estas cosas por el menos importante de estos, tampoco las {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondra, disant : “En vérité, je vous le dis : dans la mesure où vous ne [l’]avez pas fait à l’un de ces plus petits, à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} non plus vous ne [l’]avez pas fait.”
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondra : “En vérité, je vous le dis : chaque fois que vous ne l’avez pas fait pour l’un de ceux-ci, même pour le plus petit d’entre eux, c’est pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous ne l’avez pas fait.”
fr.R: Alors le Roi répondra : “Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : quand vous n’avez pas fait cela pour le moins important de ces gens, c’est pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que vous ne l’avez pas fait.”

sw.L: Kisha atawajibu, akisema, 'Kweli nawaambia, kila ambacho hamkumfanyia mmoja wa hawa walio wadogo kuliko wote, hamkunifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia.'
sw.B: Kisha atawajibu, 'Kweli nawaambia, kila mara mliposhindwa kumfanyia jambo hilo mmoja wa hawa, hata yule mdogo kuliko wote, mlishindwa kunifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}.'
sw.R: Kisha Mfalme atajibu, 'Nawaambia ukweli: msipomfanyia mambo haya hata yule asiye na umuhimu kati ya hawa, hamkunifanyia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia.'

vi.L: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trả lời họ rằng: 'Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, khi các người đã không làm [điều đó] cho một người trong những người hèn mọn nhất này, là các người cũng đã không làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đáp: 'Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các người, mỗi khi các người không làm điều đó cho một người trong những người này, dù là người nhỏ bé nhất, là các người đã không làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Bấy giờ Vua sẽ trả lời: 'Ta nói thật với các người, khi các người không làm những việc ấy cho một người trong những người này, dù là người nhỏ bé nhất, là các người đã không làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 그때에 그가 그들에게 대답하여 말할 것이다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 이 가장 작은 사람들 가운데 하나에게 [그것을] 하지 않은 만큼, 너희가 나에게도 [그것을] 하지 않은 것이다.'
ko.B: 그러면 그가 대답할 것이다. '진실로 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 이 사람들 가운데 하나에게, 그것도 가장 작은 사람 하나에게 이 일을 하지 않을 때마다, 그것은 곧 나에게 하지 않은 것이다.'
ko.R: 그러면 왕이 대답할 것이다. '내가 분명히 말한다. 너희가 이 사람들 가운데 가장 보잘것없는 사람에게 이런 일을 하지 않을 때마다, 너희는 그 일을 나에게 하지 않은 것이다.'

am.R: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ እንዲህ ብሎ ይመልስላቸዋል፦ “እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ፣ እነዚህን ነገሮች ከእነዚህ መካከል ከሁሉም ዝቅተኛ ለሆነው እንኳ ባላደረጋችሁ ጊዜ ለእኔም አላደረጋችሁትም።”

en.L: And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."
en.B: These will depart to eternal punishment, and the righteous will go to eternal life."
en.R: Then these people will go away to eternal punishment. But the righteous people will go to eternal life."

es.R: Entonces esa gente se irá al castigo eterno. Pero los justos irán a la vida eterna».

fr.L: Et ceux-ci s’en iront au châtiment éternel, mais les justes à la vie éternelle. »
fr.B: Ceux-ci s’en iront au châtiment éternel, et les justes iront à la vie éternelle. »
fr.R: Alors ces gens s’en iront vers une punition éternelle. Mais les justes iront vers la vie éternelle. »

decisions.choice: eternal: belonging to the age to come, without end
decisions.reason: The same word describes the punishment and the life, setting them side by side (Daniel 12:2). Whether the punishment is conscious without end or a ruin that cannot be undone is not settled by this verse (compare 10:28).

decisions.choice: punishment: penalty given in judgment
decisions.reason: The word can mean correction, but here it is the judge's sentence.

decisions.choice: the end of Jesus's speech that began at 24:4
decisions.reason: The teaching on the Mount of Olives ends here; 26:1 returns to the story.

decisions.choice: eterno, eterna: one word for both
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same word for the punishment and for the life (meaning decision m1), so Spanish keeps one word for both at every level.

decisions.choice: ya milele for both; uzima wa milele
decisions.reason: The Greek uses the same word for the punishment and for the life (meaning decision m1), so Swahili says "ya milele" and "wa milele" for both. "Uzima wa milele" is the term for eternal life used through the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "hình phạt đời đời" and "sự sống đời đời"
decisions.reason: The Greek uses one adjective for both, so Vietnamese keeps one word, "đời đời", the style guide's word for eternal life, at every level.

decisions.choice: "영원한 형벌" (L, B), "영원한 벌" (R); "영원한 생명" at every level
decisions.reason: The same adjective for both, as in the Greek (meaning decision); "영원한 생명" is the style guide's key term. Literal brackets the verb the Greek leaves understood.
